card.name: Linking words before stop or discontinue
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to", "was", "at", "no" or a comma that come right before a verb meaning stop, interrupt, intercept or discontinue. The next word is expected to be stop, interrupt or discontinue.

modes.label: Failing or trying to stop
modes.description: A word like "to" after "did nothing" or "harder" that leads into stop or intercept.
modes.example: I did nothing<< to>> stop it. I suppose I could have

modes.label: Interrupted by a signal
modes.description: Words in the phrase "was interrupted by a signal" in error-code lists.
modes.example: EINTR The call<< was>> interrupted by a signal. EMFILE Too

modes.label: The instruction to discontinue the infusion
modes.description: Words in overdose or infusion-reaction instructions that lead into discontinue or stop the drug.
modes.example: the first step in the management of toxicity should be<< to>> discontinue RAPIBLYK infusion
